## KEY POINT

Although men and women experience similar relative increases in muscle hypertrophy following regimented resistance training, men achieve significantly greater absolute gains, which is seemingly attributed, at least in part, to their higher testosterone levels.

has been reported in other studies as well (72). So although women can build appreciable muscle from regimented resistance exercise, their hypertrophic potential is somewhat less on average than that of men.
